code_examples.section: ltm rule command AVR disable cspm injection
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

AVR::disable_cspm_injection
       Disables CSPM injection for the current connection.

SYNOPSIS
       AVR::disable_cspm_injection

DESCRIPTION
       The CSPM (Client Side Performance Monitoring) feature injects JavaScript into HTTP responses to track the Page Load Time
       metric. This command disables CSPM JavaScropt injection.

       Syntax

       AVR::disable_cspm_injection

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       AVR_CSPM_INJECTION, HTTP_RESPONSE

EXAMPLES
	To make decisons based on request headers use event AVR_CSPM_INJECTION

	when AVR_CSPM_INJECTION {
	    if { [HTTP::header "User-Agent"] contains "MSIE" } {
		AVR::disable_cspm_injection
	    }
	}

	To make decisions based on response headers use HTTP_RESPONSE

	when HTTP_RESPONSE {
	    if { [HTTP::status] == 404 } {
		AVR::disable_cspm_injection
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.2.0 --First introduced the command.
